content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Does anyone know what's happening with the [product_name] app on Android devices? Is it no longer supported? When I try to buy a new control, I get an error saying "The item you requested is not available for purchase". Thank you for any information!
I previously asked about the [product_name] app. Honestly, this app is unreliable. It's not worth spending much time on.
You should submit a support request and contact [company_name] for clarification.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unable to purchase controls through the [product_name] app on Android, encountering a message that the requested item is unavailable. There is uncertainty about ongoing support for the app with Android devices, and some users express dissatisfaction with the app's reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to purchase controls via the [product_name] app on Android, with continued maintenance and full support for the application.
